We're a family of four, and we're staying in London for a week.</lang> <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m9'>There are group tickets, but they're only for groups of ten or more people. If you're planning to explore the city by walking around, I'd recommend single tickets. If you plan to take public transport a lot, you could either buy Travel cards which are valid 24 hours, or Visitor Oyster Cards.</voice>

atoms.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>What are Visitor Oyster Cards?</lang> <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m9'>Visitor Oyster Cards are prepaid travel cards. You have to pay £5 to obtain the card. Then, you put money on the card and pay for each ride until you reach a certain limit, depending on which zones you want to travel through. When you reach the daily limit, all rides after are free. As a bonus, you also get discounts for boat tours on River Thames or the Cloud Cable Car.</voice>
